name: Костюм
note: She wears an elegant monochromatic ivory ensemble: a fluid cape-style blouse with a high boat neckline, smooth satin-like drape, and dramatic wide fluttering sleeves that fall loosely over the arms. High-waisted wide-leg trousers in the same creamy tone feature sharp front pleats, a slim matching belt with a metallic buckle at the waist, and a flowing full-length cut. Accessories include a small structured crescent shoulder bag in matching ivory, pointed-toe heels, and a slim gold wristwatch. The overall look is sleek, sophisticated, and modern with a soft luxurious texture.

name: Незамерзайка
note: She wears a long, tailored brown overcoat of soft wool-like fabric with structured lapels and a double-breasted cut, left open over a fitted black turtleneck top. High-waisted black wide-leg trousers in smooth, tailored fabric feature sharp front pleats and a slim black leather belt with a gold buckle. Black pointed-toe stiletto heels complete the look, along with a compact black leather handbag with gold chain strap and clasp, gold hoop earrings, and a slim wristwatch.
